strings.policy.data-subject-rights.summary: You may Herunterladen a Kopieren of your health logs, request correction, withdraw consent, or Löschen local and cloud data from Einstellungen. Contact the operator for formal data-subject requests.
strings.policy.data-subject-rights.title: Your data rights
strings.policy.eu-gdpr.summary: Health data is special-category data under GDPR Art. 9. We rely on your explicit consent to process it locally and for optional cloud, research, and AI features. You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection.
strings.policy.eu-gdpr.title: EEA & UK - GDPR
strings.policy.global-baseline.summary: Rianell stores health logs on your device by default. Cloud backup, anonymised research contribution, and on-device AI are optional and require separate consent. You can Exportieren or Löschen your data at any time.
strings.policy.global-baseline.title: Global privacy baseline

strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-au.summary: Australian Privacy Principles apply to personal information we hold. You may access and correct your data and complain to the OAIC.
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-au.title: Australia
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-br.summary: LGPD grants confirmation, access, correction, anonymisation, portability, deletion, and information about sharing. Health data may receive heightened protection.
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-br.title: Brazil (LGPD)
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-us-ca.summary: We do not sell personal information. California residents have rights to know, Löschen, and correct personal information. Health logs are consumer wellness data, not HIPAA-covered provider records unless you use Rianell under a healthcare BAA.
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-us-ca.title: California (CCPA/CPRA)
strings.policy.other-jurisdictions-us.summary: Consumer wellness self-tracking is generally outside HIPAA unless you are a covered entity or business associate. State privacy laws may grant access and deletion rights similar to our global baseline.

strings.tutorial.slide0.body: Do you want to use AI Analysis (patterns, insights, summary) and Goals & targets? You can turn this on later in Einstellungen.
strings.tutorial.slide1.body: Track your health daily: log Symptome, food, exercise, Schmerz areas, and more in one place.
strings.tutorial.slide1.title: Willkommen
strings.tutorial.slide2.body: View Logs shows your history. AI Analysis finds patterns and correlations across your data.
strings.tutorial.slide2.title: Übersicht & KI
strings.tutorial.slide3.accountBody: Create an account to Speichern your data encrypted in the cloud and sync between devices.
strings.tutorial.slide3.body: In Einstellungen, you can create an account to Speichern your data encrypted in the cloud and Teilen between devices.
strings.tutorial.slide3.openData: Use open data for training AI - when on, AI uses open shared data; when off, AI uses only your personal data. Used for personalised AI analysis and advice.

strings.tutorial.slide5.body: Barrierefreiheit options help you make the app easier to read and use from day one. You can change these anytime later in Einstellungen → Barrierefreiheit.
strings.tutorial.slide5.largeTextHint: Quick preset for bigger text across the app.

strings.tutorial.slide5.title: Datenoptionen
strings.tutorial.slide5.ttsHint: Tap buttons/controls to hear their label read aloud.
strings.tutorial.slide6.body: Set Goals & targets with the target button next to Einstellungen. Choose daily targets for steps, hydration, Schlaf score, and good days per week.
strings.tutorial.slide6.progress: Your progress and "Last 7 days vs targets" appear on the Home tab so you can see how you're doing.
strings.tutorial.slide6.title: Ziele & Vorgaben
strings.tutorial.slide7.body: You're all set. Schließen to start logging, try Demo Mode, or create an account to Speichern your data in the cloud.
strings.tutorial.slide7.title: Alles bereit
strings.tutorial.slide8.body: Optional cycle tracking on step 1 of the log wizard records cycle day, phase, and flow. Rianell can suggest your phase from your last entry and today's date.
